cover.headline:
"Too old to
build muscle?"
They were
[hl]90.[/hl]
cover.sub: 8 weeks of lifting in a nursing home.

image.label: ai
image.alt: Empty leg extension machine in a bright gym

study.headline: Ten frail nursing home residents, average age 90, did hard strength training for 8 weeks.
study.note: 9 of 10 finished. Their walking speed improved 48%.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan flexing both biceps, abs visible

exhibit_b.caption: Over 40. I lift 7 days a week.
exhibit_b.headline: If 90 can grow, so can 40.

verdict.headline:
Muscle grows
[y]at any age.[/y]
You have to load it.
verdict.body: The oldest one in the study was 96. Your excuse is weaker than theirs.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan now, shirtless in green shorts, hands on hips

items: Lift 3 days a week. Hit every big muscle.
Add a rep or a little weight each week.
Free weights feel shaky? Start on machines.
works.headline:
It's not too late.
[hl]You're right on time.[/hl]
works.save: Save this for the next time someone tells you you're too old to build muscle.
